meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 给已安装的 Dial 通道再加一个电话号码。一个 NanoClaw 安装可同时接多个号码,每个号码是独立的公开线程线路,可指定由哪个 agent group 应答,回复从收到消息的号码发出。
howto.when: 当 Dial 通道已安装,你想再给 agent 加一个电话号码(比如个人线加客服线)时触发;若 Dial 未安装,需先运行 /add-dial。

say.text: 给我的 agent 再加一个 Dial 号码
say.note: 会先检查 Dial 是否已安装

say.text: 把这个号码 +14155550123 接到我的 agent 上
say.note: 核对号码归属并要求填线路名和准入策略

say.text: 这条新线路只允许已知用户发消息
say.note: 即把 inbound_access 设为 strict

howto.what_en: Adds another phone number to an installed Dial channel. One NanoClaw install can serve several numbers; each is its own public threaded line wired to a chosen agent group, and replies leave from the number texted.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an extra number for the agent (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). If Dial is not installed, run /add-dial first.

say_en.text: Add another Dial number for my agent
say_en.note: Checks that Dial is installed first.
Verifies the number, then asks for a line name and policy.

say_en.text: Make this new line strict only
say_en.note: Sets inbound_access to strict for that number.
